label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
**Subject: Re: Nia's hen - Tenby final plan + money!!**

Beth,

Just you this, not the group. I'm not taking sides and I'm not having a go, so please don't read this as a row.

I've just landed off a Lagos flight and my head's mush, so bear with me. I swapped Orlando with Kerry at work to get Nia's weekend off — cost me a night stop I really wanted — so I'm not going to pretend I don't care whether you're there.

You'd only need to be in Tenby for 6 on the Saturday. You could get the train from Cardiff Central, about two and a half hours, and I'll pick you up from the station. You can kip in with me Saturday night, I've got the twin room. If the Friday at the cottage is too much, skip it — just come Saturday, even if it's only the meal.

I know it's grim with Lowri. The row at her 40th in November, you said something about her ex and it went from there, and you both said things. I honestly think she's sorry really, she's just stubborn — same as you. I'm not asking you to make up with her.

Nia rang me last week crying, asking if you were still coming. She doesn't know you've pulled out. You sat with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019, Beth. She won't forget that. And she'll remember who wasn't there either. I think you'll regret it if you don't come.

Don't send Lowri the £85 yet. Hang on a bit.

Nia's wedding is 17 April at Margam and you're doing a reading, so you'll see her then anyway. But this is different.

I'll pick you up. Just say yes to Saturday.

Siân x
